scope_note: The GATING floor: industry-curated 1.0 criteria ANY software product must meet, merged into emitted spines as the `origin: generic-baseline` floor (lens_mine merge_baseline) and usable directly in a check battery. Superset of generic-software.baseline.json — that file is FROZEN as the measurement control (every historical lift number was measured against its 20 categories; do not edit it). New floor categories are distilled from OpenSSF Scorecard checks, OpenSSF Best Practices Badge criteria, the GitHub community profile, and the SRE launch checklist — curated to artifact-checkable items only (no process-only criteria).
derived_from: generic-software.baseline.json (frozen control, 20 categories verbatim or alias-refined)

required.aliases: error handling / exception handling / error messages / graceful failure
required.day1_tell: Feed it malformed input and a dead dependency; confirm a useful error, not a stack trace or silent wrong answer.

required.aliases: logging / log levels / debug output / diagnostics
required.day1_tell: Reproduce a failure and confirm the logs alone are enough to localize it (level, context, no secrets).

required.aliases: input validation / sanitization / malformed input handling
required.day1_tell: Send hostile input (oversized, wrong type, injection-shaped) at every external boundary and confirm rejection.

required.aliases: configuration / config files / settings / environment variables / defaults
required.day1_tell: Boot with zero config (sane defaults), then override one value via file AND env var; confirm precedence is documented.

required.aliases: documentation / README / usage docs / examples
required.day1_tell: A new user completes install → first successful use from the README alone, no source reading.

required.aliases: tests / unit tests / integration tests / test fixes
required.day1_tell: Run the test suite from a fresh clone with one documented command; confirm it exercises the core path, not just helpers.

required.aliases: continuous integration / build pipeline / release automation
required.day1_tell: Push a failing commit and confirm CI blocks it; push a tag and confirm an artifact is produced.

required.aliases: dependency updates / version bumps / library upgrades / dependabot / renovate / automated updates
required.day1_tell: Confirm dependencies are pinned/lockfiled and an automated update mechanism (or documented cadence) exists.

required.aliases: performance / speed / memory usage / optimization
required.day1_tell: Run the core operation on a realistic-sized input and confirm latency/memory are measured, not assumed.

required.aliases: security / vulnerability fix / secrets handling / permissions
required.day1_tell: Grep for secrets in repo/logs (none), confirm least-privilege defaults, and run a dependency audit clean.

required.aliases: packaging / install / distribution / setup
required.day1_tell: Install via the documented package-manager path on a clean machine and run the entry point.

required.aliases: versioning / semver / version tagging / release cadence
required.day1_tell: Confirm released versions are tagged, semver-meaningful, and the running binary reports its version.

required.aliases: retries / timeouts / backoff / transient failure handling
required.day1_tell: Kill a dependency mid-call: confirm bounded timeout, backoff retry, and a clean failure after exhaustion.

required.aliases: cache / caching layer / cache invalidation
required.day1_tell: Identify what is cached, force staleness, and confirm invalidation works (no permanently wrong answers).

required.aliases: metrics / monitoring / observability / usage tracking
required.day1_tell: Confirm the system emits enough signal (metrics/health/structured logs) to detect it being broken without a user report.

required.aliases: auth / login / API keys / access control
required.day1_tell: Attempt the privileged operation unauthenticated and as a wrong-role user; both must fail safely.

required.aliases: database / persistence / schema migration / data integrity
required.day1_tell: Upgrade from a previous-version data dir/schema and confirm data survives; kill -9 mid-write and confirm no corruption.

required.aliases: user interface / usability / display fixes / formatting
required.day1_tell: Walk the golden path as a first-time user; confirm empty states, long values, and errors all render intentionally.

required.aliases: i18n / localization / translations
required.day1_tell: Feed non-ASCII input end-to-end (CJK, emoji, RTL) and confirm no mangling; locale strings externalized if user-facing.

required.aliases: resource leaks / file handles / memory cleanup / shutdown handling
required.day1_tell: Run a soak loop and confirm stable handles/memory; SIGTERM mid-work and confirm graceful shutdown.

required.aliases: SECURITY.md / vulnerability reporting / disclosure policy / security contact
required.day1_tell: Find the documented vulnerability-reporting channel (SECURITY.md) and confirm a reporter could use it without filing a public issue.

required.aliases: LICENSE / license metadata / copyright / third-party notices
required.day1_tell: Confirm a LICENSE file exists and the package metadata declares the same license.

required.aliases: CONTRIBUTING / code of conduct / issue templates / PR templates
required.day1_tell: From CONTRIBUTING.md alone, a new contributor can set up, run tests, and submit a change.

required.aliases: CHANGELOG / keep-a-changelog / dated release notes / breaking-change notes
required.day1_tell: Open the changelog: latest release has a dated, sectioned entry that calls out breaking changes separately.

required.aliases: lint / linter / static analysis / formatter / type checking in CI
required.day1_tell: Run the project's lint/typecheck command locally and confirm CI enforces the same check.

optional.aliases: signed releases / checksums / sigstore / SLSA / build provenance
optional.day1_tell: Download a release artifact and verify its checksum or signature by the documented method.

optional.aliases: SBOM / software bill of materials / dependency disclosure
optional.day1_tell: Generate or locate the published SBOM for the latest release.
Find a fuzz or property-based target exercising the main parser/input boundary; run it briefly.

optional.aliases: upgrade guide / UPGRADING.md / deprecation warnings / breaking-change policy
optional.day1_tell: Trigger a deprecated path: it warns with the removal version and a migration pointer; an upgrade guide exists.

optional.aliases: privacy policy / data collection disclosure / telemetry opt-out
optional.day1_tell: Find documentation of what data is collected/stored and a working opt-out for any telemetry.
